exercises.question: Which sentence normally requires the subjunctive? [¿Cuál normalmente requiere subjuntivo?]
options: No creo que sea necesario. [I don't think it is necessary.]
Estoy seguro de que es necesario. [I am sure it is necessary.]
Sé que es necesario. [I know it is necessary.]

exercises.sentence: Puede que ___ razón. [They may be right.]

exercises.english: I am sure that it works.

sentences: Primero, Ana revisó los datos. [First, Ana checked the data.]
Después, habló con sus compañeros. [Then she talked with her colleagues.]
Finalmente, dijo: «No estoy seguro de que tenga razón». [Finally, she said: “I am not sure he/she is right.”]

exercises.question: Which sentence correctly expresses evaluation? [¿Cuál expresa correctamente una valoración?]
options: Es importante que participen. [It is important that they participate.]
Es importante que participan. [It is important that they participate.]
Es importante si participan. [It is important if they participate.]

exercises.sentence: No creo que la solución ___ perfecta. [I don't think the solution is perfect.]
exercises.english: I don't think the solution is perfect.
It is possible that they are right.

exercises.question: Which sentence best integrates certainty, doubt and evaluation? [¿Cuál integra mejor certeza, duda y valoración?]
options: Estoy seguro de que puede ayudar, pero no creo que sea suficiente y es importante que estudiemos otras opciones. [I am sure it can help, but I don't think it is enough and it is important that we study other options.]
Estoy completamente seguro de que esta propuesta técnica puede ayudar a solucionar el problema. [I am completely sure that this technical proposal can help solve the problem.]

No sé con certeza cuál es la mejor alternativa porque todavía no conocemos todos los detalles. [I do not know with certainty which is the best alternative because we still do not know all the details.]
I don't think it is necessary.
I am sure it is necessary.
It is possible that it is necessary.

exercises.sentence: No creo que la solución sea perfecta, aunque estoy seguro de que puede ayudar.
options: I don't think the solution is perfect, although I am sure it can help.
I am sure the solution is perfect.
I don't think the solution can help at all.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que escuchemos otras opiniones.
exercises.english: It is important that we listen to other opinions.

options: Sí, es posible que llegue tarde. [Yes, it is possible that he will arrive late.]
No, es posible que llega tarde. [No, it is possible that he arrives late.]
Sí, dudo que llegue tarde. [Yes, I doubt that he will arrive late.]
No creo que sea perfecta. [I don't think it is perfect.]
No creo que es perfecta. [I don't think it is perfect.]
No creo si sea perfecta. [I don't think if it is perfect.]
Es importante que estudiemos otras opciones. [It is important that we study other options.]
Es importante que estudiamos otras opciones. [It is important that we study other options.]
Es posible que estudiamos otras opciones. [It is possible that we study other options.]

exercises.question: Which sentence gives a balanced opinion? [¿Cuál da una opinión equilibrada?]
options: No creo que la solución sea perfecta, aunque estoy convencido de que puede ayudar. [I don't think the solution is perfect, although I am convinced it can help.]
La solución técnica propuesta por el equipo de ingenieros es totalmente perfecta. [The technical solution proposed by the engineering team is totally perfect.]
La nueva propuesta resulta completamente inútil y no sirve para resolver nada. [The new proposal turns out completely useless and is of no use for solving anything.]

template.prompt: Express certainty and doubt about the same idea.
template.answer: Estoy seguro de que puede ayudar, pero no estoy seguro de que sea suficiente.

template.prompt: Write a short nuanced opinion using negated opinion, possibility and evaluation.
template.answer: No creo que haya una solución perfecta. Es posible que existan varias opciones y es importante que las estudiemos antes de decidir.
